competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 35% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to stun the target for 1 turn with a 30% chance and decrease their Attack Bar by 30% with a 30% chance. Increases your Attack Bar by 30% if the target is stunned. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects from yourself and 2 allies with the lowest HP and grants Immunity for 3 turns. Then, attacks the enemy target together with the target allies and removes all beneficial effects from the target.

effets.note: Yourself and two allies with the lowest HP

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
effets.note: Yourself and two allies with the lowest HP

effets.description: Brings one or more allies to attack at the same time.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
